description:
Create a 3D-printable nameplate in FreeCAD.

1. Create a rectangular base plate on the XY plane with dimensions: Length=100mm, Width=30mm, Height=3mm (use Part Design Pad or Part Extrude).
2. Create 3D text on top of the base plate reading "ROBOT-01".
   - Use the 'ShapeString' tool (Draft or Part workbench).
   - Font: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf
   - Height: 12mm
   - Position: Centered on the top face of the base plate (Z=3mm).
3. Extrude the text upwards by 2mm so it stands out from the plate.
4. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/nameplate.FCStd'.
5. Select the final geometry and export it as an STL mesh to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/nameplate.stl'.
